query: Bordeaux France taxi Uber fare per km base fare 2026
snippet: Traditional taxi: base fare 2.60 EUR, 0.99 EUR/km daytime (07:00-19:00, Tariff A), 1.48 EUR/km night/Sunday/holidays (Tariff B). Uber: base fare 1.2 EUR, 1.2 EUR/km, minimum charge 6.00 EUR. A 5km Uber ride costs about 10.5 EUR. Uber does not offer standard vehicles in Bordeaux, only UberX.
